t.zh: 相机台上的长度以毫米计，图里的长度以像素计。这台相机的传感器高 20 mm，竖直方向排着 200 个像素。
t.en: Lengths on the camera bench are in millimetres, lengths in the image in pixels. This camera's sensor is 20 mm tall and holds 200 pixels from top to bottom.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：物体在图里高 100 像素，实高 120 mm，离相机 600 mm，镜头的焦距是多少毫米？三个任务：先算出焦距，再到相机台上验证，最后写出以像素计的焦距和这台相机竖直方向的<wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: This level asks: an object is 100 pixels tall in the image, 120 mm tall in reality and 600 mm from the camera — what is the lens's focal length in millimetres? Three tasks: work it out, check it on the camera bench, then give the focal length in pixels and this camera's vertical <wiki-ref to="field-of-view"></wiki-ref>.

after.zh: 物理焦距除以像素尺寸，就是<wiki-ref to="pixel-units"></wiki-ref>：焦距换成图像坐标的单位，视场也能直接用像素算。
after.en: The physical focal length over the pixel size is the <wiki-ref to="pixel-units"></wiki-ref>: the focal length in the image's own units, from which the field of view follows in pixels.

brief.zh: 由像素高、实高和距离，算出镜头的焦距（毫米）。
brief.en: From the height in pixels, the real height and the distance, work out the lens's focal length in millimetres.

hint.zh: 相似三角形两边的长度要用同一种单位。
hint.en: Both sides of the similar triangles must be in one unit.

prompt.zh: 图里高 100 像素，实高 120 mm，距离 600 mm：焦距多少毫米？
prompt.en: 100 pixels tall in the image, 120 mm tall, 600 mm away: how many millimetres is f?

prompt.zh: 图里高 80 像素，实高 400 mm，距离 2000 mm：焦距多少毫米？
prompt.en: 80 pixels tall in the image, 400 mm tall, 2000 mm away: how many millimetres is f?

brief.zh: 物高 120 mm、距离 600 mm：调焦距，让像在图里高 100 像素。
brief.en: Object 120 mm tall, 600 mm away: set the focal length so the image is 100 pixels tall.

why.zh: 把 100 像素当成 100 mm 代进比例：像高 100 mm，比整块 20 mm 的传感器还高。
why.en: Putting 100 pixels into the ratio as 100 mm: the image is 100 mm tall, taller than the whole 20 mm sensor.

brief.zh: 这台相机 f = 50 mm，每个像素 0.1 mm：写出它以像素计的焦距和竖直方向的视场。
brief.en: This camera has f = 50 mm and 0.1 mm pixels: give its focal length in pixels and its vertical field of view.

prompt.zh: 以像素计的焦距是多少？
prompt.en: What is the focal length in pixels?

prompt.zh: 竖直方向的视场大约多宽？
prompt.en: About how wide is the vertical field of view?
